newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Oct 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Oct 9.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- National Assembly adopts plan to cut social security deficit down to 30 billion francs, government may scale down costly TGV high-speed train programme, some members of the majority call for a cut in value added tax to 20 percent from 20.6 percent.
-- Axa Australian subsidiary National Mutual successfully floated in Australia and New Zealand, providing Axa with a capital gain of nearly 2.3 billion francs.

-- Eurotunnel shares tumble on details of debt-restucturing agreement. Analysts say an extension to 99 years of the Channel tunnel operator's 65-year concession would improve the company's value by 50 percent.
-- Coface export insurance agency buys German credit insurance agency AKV.
-- Eramet nickel producer says board to conduct in-depth study of a proposal by state-controlled ERAP to change the legal status of the company, adding a supervisory and a management board.
-- Tour operator Nouvelles Frontieres may be interested in bidding for ailing airline Air Liberte as well as British Airways, deadline for tenders is Oct 14.
